Maya Chen: Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone rollup. runtime-v2 canary goes live today; need owners to confirm what shipped vs slipped and any immediate unblock asks.

Samir Patel: Shipping note — model-routing fallback tests ✅ merged (PR #4321). I pushed the canary config earlier.

Liam O'Connor: CR for kernel-selection patch still has 1 reviewer outstanding (waiting on @Priya). small potential perf regression if not approved.

Anya Rodriguez: Docs slipped — private-deploy KMS section blocked by security review. ETA pushed to Tue next week unless review moves faster.

Priya Kapoor: I can pick up reviews tonight; will prioritize #4321 and #4333. If tests pass I'll approve.

Deploy Bot: deploy-bot: canary started on prod-dedicated-01 at 3439901280 — routing 10% traffic.

Maya Chen: Thanks. For the OKR spreadsheet mark latency p50 as "partial" — our load run hit 52ms (target 50ms). Next action: try batching tweak from Optimize.

Samir Patel: Updated the board, assigned owners: runtime-batching -> Liam O'Connor, private-docs -> Anya Rodriguez, canary-monitoring -> Samir Patel.

Liam O'Connor: I'll run the perf sweep Mon 09:00 and open a rollback plan if p50 > 55ms. Plan to test these configs:```batch_size: auto
max_latency: 40ms
kv_cache_prefetch: true```

Anya Rodriguez: Security review scheduled Mon 10:00 with Priya + infra-sec. If cleared, docs PR will be ready by Tue EOD. I'll tag customer-facing pages in the PR.

Priya Kapoor: Confirmed invite sent. Will review security notes and expedite approvals after the meeting.

Evan Morales: Quick product question — do doc wording changes need product signoff before merge? I can do a quick pass if helpful.

Maya Chen: Product signoff only for external-facing docs. Anya, please flag which pages require Evan's review.

Anya Rodriguez: Will add "external" labels in the PR and ping Evan for a quick review.

Samir Patel: Canary metrics: 10% traffic stable so far. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.dev/ops/34399 — watching error-rate and p50.

Priya Kapoor: :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: TL;DR next steps — monitor canary 12h, if green -> gradual rollout; if regressions -> rollback. Owners: monitoring=Samir, batching changes=Liam, docs=Anya. Next async check-in on Thursday. Ping here for any urgent blockers.

Liam O'Connor: Acknowledged — will post perf sweep results in this thread.

Anya Rodriguez: Acknowledged — will update PR labels and ETA after Mon review.

Samir Patel: Acknowledged — will set alert if error-rate > 1%.

Maya Chen: Great — thanks all! :rocket:
